description: Disposition of every directory under examples/ for the phased Vellum cut (macOS first). The classification follows what each example links and includes, not its name. tools/scripts/examples_manifest_guard.py keeps this file and the directory in step.

classes.audio-only: Retained in Pulp. No link to pulp::view, pulp::render or pulp::canvas and no include from pulp/view, pulp/render or pulp/canvas. A plug-in here has either no editor or only the framework-default editor, which it does not write code for.
classes.moves-to-vellum: Retained, with its UI consumed from Vellum. The example links or includes the view, render or canvas layers, or sets a GPU or full editor stack, so it is rebuilt against the Vellum SDK when those layers leave Pulp.
classes.quarantined: UI-off on the platform until that platform's Vellum host exists. The example moves under the legacy platform hosts with the code it needs and is deleted in the named later phase.
classes.deleted: Removed. The entry must give the reason.
